proposals.evidence: Turner’s markáṭa monkey article explicitly includes Marathi mākaḍ, Gujarati mākṛũ/mā̃kṛũ and Prakrit makkaḍa/makkaḍī, with probable older Dravidian ancestry. These western survey forms retain the diagnostic māk-ḍ/ṛ sequence and regional final i/y-vowels; sporadic aspiration is preserved as a source variant. The separate mārkaṭa article 10069 has monkey-like/lean/reddish senses and is not the selected noun parent.
